project_overview: A system for managing police cases with features for registration, investigation, prosecution, and auditing, designed to meet high security and usability standards.

actors.name: Admin
actors.description: Administrator with full system access and user management privileges

actors.name: PoliceOfficer
actors.description: Officer responsible for case registration, investigation and prosecution

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: Public user who can submit complaints and track cases

actors.name: HelpDesk
actors.description: Support staff handling user issues and defect tracking

actors.name: Auditor
actors.description: External auditor reviewing system activity and audit trails

actors.name: System
actors.description: Automated system processes and background jobs

functions.name: AuditActions
functions.description: Track and log all system actions for audit purposes
sub_capabilities: Capture create/read/update/delete actions on critical entities
Store date and time of events
acceptance_criteria: All critical actions must be logged
functions.preconditions: Audit trail functionality must be activated

functions.name: ManageAccess
functions.description: Control access to cases and system functionality
sub_capabilities: Limit case access to specified users/groups
acceptance_criteria: Only admin can set up user profiles
Users can belong to multiple groups

entities.name: AuditTrail
entities.description: Immutable record of system actions and events

attributes.name: entityType
attributes.description: Type of entity affected by the action

relationships.description: Audit entries may reference specific cases

entities.name: AccessControl
entities.description: Configuration of user permissions and case access

constraints.description: System must maintain unalterable audit trail
constraints.source_text: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word 'unalterable' is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.
Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

constraints.description: Audit trail must be maintained for case lifetime
constraints.source_text: The System must maintain the audit trail for as long as required, which will be at least for the life of the case to which it refers.

constraints.description: System must allow case access limitation
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: Only admins can manage user profiles
constraints.source_text: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

exceptions.trigger: User attempts to access restricted case
exceptions.handling: Log violation in audit trail and show appropriate error message

exceptions.trigger: System unable to export audit data

non_functional_requirements.description: Simple search must complete within 5-8 seconds, advanced search within 10-15 seconds
System must prevent cross-site scripting and SQL injection
System must use HTTPS for all communications
System must support selective data encryption
Error messages must be meaningful with suggested actions
System must work in offline mode with critical functionality
System must implement Service Oriented Architecture (SOA)
